'''Polar water''' was one of the drinks [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] kept in her beverage center.<ref name="abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref> 

The beverage was among those served at the [[Outer Rim Restaurant and Lounge]] at [[Spaceport THX1138]].<ref name="abyss" />
